**[Suggestion]** The no-session fallback `selectedWorkspaceCwd ?? connection.workspaceCwd` reverts to the stale `connection.workspaceCwd` when `selectedWorkspaceCwd` is `undefined` — which is exactly the state the plain "new chat" path produces in an unlocked multi-workspace daemon (`createNewSession()` with no argument sets `selectedWorkspaceCwd = lockedWorkspaceCwd ?? undefined = undefined`). The two sibling resolvers (`activeWorkspaceCwd` at line 1571 and `getComposerWorkspaceCwd` at line 3360) both fall back to the primary workspace, not to `connection.workspaceCwd`. — Concrete cost: in an unlocked multi-workspace daemon, user had a session on a secondary workspace, clicks "new chat" → `clearSession()` drops `sessionId` while `connection.workspaceCwd` still points at the secondary → the effect reports the stale secondary to the host while the UI chip and the actual next session both target the primary — the same misrouting this PR sets out to eliminate, surviving on the most common new-chat path.

```suggestion
  const reportedWorkspaceCwd = connection.sessionId
    ? connection.workspaceCwd
    : (selectedWorkspaceCwd ??
      workspaces.find((entry) => entry.primary)?.cwd ??
      connection.workspaceCwd);
```

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

**[建议]** 无会话时的回退 `selectedWorkspaceCwd ?? connection.workspaceCwd` 在 `selectedWorkspaceCwd` 为 `undefined` 时仍会退回到过期的 `connection.workspaceCwd`——而这恰恰是未锁定多 workspace 守护进程中普通「新建对话」路径产生的状态（无参调用 `createNewSession()` 会将 `selectedWorkspaceCwd` 设为 `lockedWorkspaceCwd ?? undefined = undefined`）。两个同级解析器（第 1571 行的 `activeWorkspaceCwd` 和第 3360 行的 `getComposerWorkspaceCwd`）都回退到主 workspace，而非 `connection.workspaceCwd`。— 具体代价：在未锁定的多 workspace 守护进程中，用户之前在 secondary workspace 有会话，点击「新建对话」→ `clearSession()` 清除 `sessionId` 而 `connection.workspaceCwd` 仍指向 secondary → effect 向 host 上报过期的 secondary，而 UI 标签和实际的下一个会话都指向 primary——本 PR 要消除的错误路由在最常见的新建对话路径上依然存在。

</details>

_— qwen3.8-max-preview via Qwen Code /review_

**[Critical]** Same incorrect assertion: `latestChatEditorProps.disabled` is always an explicit boolean from `approvalActive`, never `undefined`. With no pending approval, `approvalActive` is `false` — not `undefined`. — Failure scenario: Running `vitest run ChatPane.test.tsx` produces `AssertionError: expected false to be undefined`, failing the "adds no composer footer DOM when omitted or returning null" test.

```suggestion
    expect(composer?.nextElementSibling).toBeNull();
    expect(latestChatEditorProps.disabled).toBe(false);
```

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

**[Critical]** 同样不正确的断言：`latestChatEditorProps.disabled` 始终是来自 `approvalActive` 的显式布尔值，永远不会是 `undefined`。没有待处理审批时，`approvalActive` 为 `false`——而非 `undefined`。—— 失败场景：运行 `vitest run ChatPane.test.tsx` 会产生 `AssertionError: expected false to be undefined`，导致"adds no composer footer DOM when omitted or returning null"测试失败。

</details>

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_

**[Suggestion]** `Children.toArray(children).map(...)` with the `isValidElement` guard silently drops non-element `ReactNode` children (strings, numbers, text fragments) in the overflow menu. The type `PaneHeaderActionsRenderer` returns `ReactNode`, which permits these — so a host that returns mixed content (e.g. `[<button>Share</button>, " · ", <button>Export</button>]`) renders all three inline but loses the `" · "` separator when the pane collapses into overflow.

**Failure scenario:** A host returns a separator string between action buttons. Wide pane shows all three nodes; narrow pane collapses to overflow where the separator is replaced with `null` — buttons appear adjacent with no visual grouping.

```suggestion
              {Children.toArray(children).map((child, index) =>
                isValidElement(child) ? (
                  <DropdownMenuItem key={child.key ?? index} asChild>
                    {child}
                  </DropdownMenuItem>
                ) : (
                  <DropdownMenuItem key={index}>{child}</DropdownMenuItem>
                ),
              )}
```

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

`Children.toArray(children).map(...)` 配合 `isValidElement` 检查会在溢出菜单中静默丢弃非元素 `ReactNode` 子节点（字符串、数字、文本片段）。`PaneHeaderActionsRenderer` 返回类型为 `ReactNode`，允许这些值——因此返回混合内容的宿主（如 `[<button>Share</button>, " · ", <button>Export</button>]`）在宽窗格中三个节点都显示，但窗格收窄进入溢出时 `" · "` 分隔符被替换为 `null`。

**故障场景：** 宿主在操作按钮之间返回分隔字符串。宽窗格显示全部三个节点；窄窗格折叠为溢出菜单时分隔符消失——按钮相邻显示，没有视觉分组。

</details>

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_

Declined — filtering non-element `ReactNode` children (strings, numbers) is intentional for the overflow menu. A `" · "` separator between buttons is meaningless as a `role="menuitem"` entry; each menu item proxies a discrete host action via `onSelect → click`. The inline layout already renders all children faithfully, so no visual information is lost when the pane is wide enough. Wrapping a bare string in `DropdownMenuItem` would give it keyboard focus and selection semantics that misrepresent its purpose.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

拒绝——在溢出菜单中过滤非元素 `ReactNode` 子节点（字符串、数字）是有意为之。按钮间的 `" · "` 分隔符作为 `role="menuitem"` 条目没有意义；每个菜单项通过 `onSelect → click` 代理一个离散的宿主操作。行内布局已忠实渲染所有子节点，窗格足够宽时不会丢失任何视觉信息。将纯字符串包装为 `DropdownMenuItem` 会赋予其键盘焦点和选择语义，与其实际用途不符。

</details>
